statement: The exact Codex 0.148.0 Luna max structured-owner-duty realization is live-catalog compatible and may enter a new bounded canary, but no behavioral fit, reliability, wake delivery, or owner-acceptance evidence transfers from a Codex 0.147.0 realization.

conditions: the exact Codex 0.148.0 runtime package and its required companions are artifact-admitted before launch
the selected realization, runtime profile, model slug, reasoning effort, permissions and tool profile match exactly
a new bounded real-work canary returns runtime receipts and separately reviewed evidence before any fit promotion
the live Codex catalog remains compatible with the realization at launch time
exclusions: transferring any Codex 0.147.0 task outcome, fit, reliability, handoff, wake, resume, or acceptance claim
using catalog compatibility as activation, routing, process health, proof, or owner acceptance
claiming general Luna competence, autonomy, initiative, or evaluator authority
inferring closed-model internals or training lineage from runtime availability

evidence_refs.notes: Confirms exact 0.148.0 catalog compatibility for Luna max; it does not execute the realization or prove task fit.
The prior bounded hypothesis is stale and explicitly says a future 0.148.0 canary must re-establish currentness before fit is considered.

known_counterevidence.notes: Adjacent 0.147.0 writer and reviewer evidence exists, but the exact realization is stale and cannot establish 0.148.0 behavior.

freshness.policy: Reassess on any Codex version, package companion, live catalog, runtime profile, access, effort, permission, or tool-profile change; behavioral fit remains unestablished until a fresh reviewed canary.

history.reason: A fresh 0.148.0 catalog observation establishes only realization currentness, while the previous 0.147.0 owner-duty hypothesis and evidence are stale by exact-runtime identity.

attribution_limits: The live catalog proves availability and declared configuration compatibility only.
The new realization has not yet completed a real task through the repaired external actor route.
No 0.147.0 execution receipt, review, wake, or fit conclusion is attributed to the 0.148.0 realization.
Runtime package admission, process truth, wake delivery, proof, routing, and owner acceptance remain with their stronger owners.
